images.prompt:
Original adult colouring-book pen-and-ink artwork in a refined cosy-gothic botanical style; crisp confident black outlines, organic hand-inked curves, varied line weight and delicate controlled crosshatching. High-detail yet highly colourable forms, balancing intricate engraved textures with generous open spaces; pure black on white, no grey shading, fills or gradients. Calm, intimate, quietly enchanted autumnal mood, clean home-printable line art.

STYLE PARAMETERS: illustration style: Original adult colouring-book pen-and-ink illustration with a refined cosy-gothic domestic feel and botanical engraving influences.; line weight: Clean confident outer contours with fine-to-medium interior lines and occasional heavier focal accents.; line quality: Crisp, deliberate, hand-inked linework with gently organic curves, controlled hatching and tidy decorative embellishment.; detail level: High but colourable detail: intricate surface patterns and small decorative accents balanced by broad open areas for relaxed colouring.; background density: Layered, moderately dense backgrounds that frame the focal area without filling every space; use calm open pockets throughout.; composition: Clear focal hierarchy with a strong central feature, gently framing secondary details and an even rhythm of intricate and open colourable areas; preserve an uncluttered title area where needed.; palette: Monochrome artwork only; designs should suggest autumnal natural colour choices through recognisable tonal groupings rather than printed colour.; colour mode: black-and-white line art; shading: No solid black fills, grey tones or digital gradients. Build depth selectively with sparse crosshatching, stippling and parallel contour marks, always leaving ample room to colour.; texture: Fine pen texture with botanical-vein, aged-wood, ceramic, paper-label and wrought-detail patterning interpreted through open, printable marks.; mood: Peaceful, intimate, gently mysterious and warmly seasonal rather than frightening..

PAGE 2 of "Moonlit Potting Shed: Adult Halloween Colouring Book" (colouring): Colouring page titled “THE LANTERN BENCH”; central carved pumpkin lantern on a weathered wooden potting bench; exactly three herb jars, exactly two seed packets, watering can, trowel and gardening gloves arranged around it; arched window above with full moon, sparse clouds and curling vines; exactly three stacked terracotta pots and a basket of autumn leaves beneath the bench.

CANVAS: A single portrait design with a plain white background. Keep a clear margin on every side; nothing important touches the edges, so it prints cleanly on a home printer. It is a colouring page: clean closed outlines on white, no grey fills or shading, easy to colour. Single-sided portrait colouring pages with a clear print-safe border and balanced open areas for comfortable adult colouring. Any printed text must be short, correctly spelled and exactly as quoted.

DO NOT INCLUDE: Any copied or recognisable existing colouring-book composition, artist style, character, logo or branded motif; Photorealism, painterly rendering, colour fills, grey washes or digital gradients; Solid black areas that waste home-printer ink or obscure colourable detail; Overcrowded pages with no resting space for colouring; Tiny muddy marks, accidental tangencies or inconsistent line weights; Gory, frightening or violent horror imagery; Misspelled, malformed or AI-generated-looking text.
